result.label: Source-read

claims.claim: Another statute can require an exception to the general summons requirements.
claims.quote: Except as otherwise required by statute,

claims.claim: The summons must be directed to the defendant.
claims.quote: a summons shall be directed to the defendant

claims.claim: The clerk must sign the summons.
claims.quote: signed by the clerk

claims.claim: The summons must be issued under the seal of the court where the case is pending.
claims.quote: issued under the seal of the court in which the action is pending

claims.claim: The summons must identify the court.
claims.quote: (1) The title of the court in which the action is pending.

claims.claim: The summons must name the parties.
claims.quote: (2) The names of the parties to the action.

claims.claim: The summons must direct the defendant to file a written response with the court.
claims.quote: A direction that the defendant file with the court a written pleading in response to the complaint
claims.note: The statute calls the response a written pleading.

claims.claim: The stated filing deadline is 30 days after the summons is served on the defendant.
claims.quote: within 30 days after summons is served on the defendant.

claims.claim: The summons must warn that if the defendant does not respond, default will be entered upon the plaintiff's application.
claims.quote: A notice that, unless the defendant so responds, their default will be entered upon application by the plaintiff

claims.claim: The warning must say the plaintiff may apply to the court for the relief demanded in the complaint.
claims.quote: the plaintiff may apply to the court for the relief demanded in the complaint

claims.claim: Possible consequences include wage garnishment, taking money or property, or other relief.
claims.quote: which could result in garnishment of wages, taking of money or property, or other relief.

claims.claim: The quoted two-sentence attorney statement is required in bold type.
claims.quote: (5) The following statement in boldface type:  “You may seek the advice of an attorney in any matter connected with the complaint or this summons. Such attorney should be consulted promptly so that your pleading may be filed or entered within the time required by this summons.”

claims.claim: The introductory legend must appear at the top, above everything else.
claims.quote: at the top of the summons above all other matter

claims.claim: The legend must be bold and appear in both English and Spanish.
claims.quote: in boldface type, in English and Spanish:

claims.claim: The draft quotes the prescribed English legend.
claims.quote: “Notice!  You have been sued.  The court may decide against you without your being heard unless you respond within 30 days.  Read information below.”

claims.claim: A county may use an ordinance to require the legend in an additional foreign language in every summons issued by its courts.
claims.quote: Each county may, by ordinance, require that the legend contained in paragraph (6) of subdivision (a) be set forth in every summons issued out of the courts of that county in any additional foreign language

claims.claim: The additional-language legend must follow the same placement and bold-type requirements.
claims.quote: if the legend in the additional foreign language is set forth in the summons in the same manner as required in that paragraph.

claims.claim: A summons in a Judicial Council-approved form is treated as meeting these requirements.
claims.quote: (c) A summons in a form approved by the Judicial Council is deemed to comply with this section.

claims.claim: SUM-100 is a Judicial Council summons form.
claims.quote: Judicial Council form SUM-100 (Summons)

claims.claim: SUM-100 bears a revision date of July 1, 2009.
claims.quote: SUM-100 [Rev. July 1, 2009]

claims.claim: The notice on SUM-100 begins with the quoted heading.
claims.quote: NOTICE! You have been sued.

claims.claim: SUM-100 has a case-number field.
claims.quote: CASE NUMBER:

claims.claim: SUM-100 has a field for the court's name and address.
claims.quote: The name and address of the court is:

claims.claim: SUM-100 requests the name, address and telephone number of the plaintiff's attorney or, if unrepresented, the plaintiff.
claims.quote: The name, address, and telephone number of plaintiff's attorney, or plaintiff without an attorney, is:

result.summary: The statutory text supports the stated contents and Judicial Council form rule. The supplied SUM-100 supports the revision date, notice wording and identifying fields. The residential Section 1161 form provision is outside the stated scope.
